# DexDecor

> > DexDecor provides expert home improvement guides covering bathroom design, bedroom organization, outdoor living spaces, and DIY renovation projects with product recommendations and safety standards.

DexDecor offers practical advice for homeowners looking to enhance their living spaces through strategic design choices, code-compliant installations, and carefully selected products. The site focuses on accessible DIY projects, space optimization techniques, and creating functional yet beautiful rooms across interior and exterior spaces.

## Key Topics

- Bathroom design and remodeling
- Bedroom organization and decor
- Outdoor living and patio furniture
- NEC and IRC electrical codes
- GFCI safety requirements
- High-wind resistant umbrellas
- Color balance and interior design
- Space-saving solutions
- Mold prevention and humidity control
- Outdoor lighting and security
- Energy-efficient appliances
- DIY home improvement
- Neutral palette design
- Concrete painting and sealing
